nodes.label: doctor_cmd
nodes.doc: Check local environment, tools, and free-tier services.

nodes.label: get_context
nodes.doc: Load lightweight context for CLI commands

nodes.label: check_permission
nodes.doc: Returns (allowed, reason)

nodes.label: sanitize_no_proxy_env
nodes.doc: Fix broken NO_PROXY env that contains IPv6 bracket notation breaking httpx URLPattern

nodes.label: _is_resolvable
nodes.doc:
Fast DNS check that never blocks process exit.
Returns quickly even if getaddrinfo would block 20s, using daemon thread.
Also fast-skips host.docker.internal if not in /etc/hosts unless env allows.

nodes.label: _mcp_http_client_factory
nodes.doc: Fix NO_PROXY and create httpx AsyncClient

nodes.label: _ollama_available
nodes.doc:
Tries http://localhost:11434/api/tags and http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/tags
with httpx 2s timeout, return url base that works or None

nodes.label: _heuristic_route
nodes.doc: Fallback keyword router, no Ollama required

nodes.label: _route_with_ollama
nodes.doc: Try real Ollama routing, raise if not available

nodes.label: _load_auth
nodes.doc: Load auth registry from REG. Returns {} if missing/corrupt.

nodes.label: _save_auth
nodes.doc: Save auth registry with 0600 perms.

nodes.label: get_token
nodes.doc:
Internal helper: retrieve token for service via security.get_secret with env fallback.
Order:
  1. security.get_secret(f"{SERVICE}_TOKEN")
  2. security.get_secret(service) / service.upper()
  3. Dire

nodes.label: _resolve_client_id
nodes.doc: Resolve OAuth client_id from explicit arg, env vars, or vault.

nodes.label: _prompt_for_pat
nodes.doc: Securely prompt user for PAT/API key.

nodes.label: _do_github_device_flow
nodes.doc:
Full GitHub OAuth device flow:
POST https://github.com/login/device/code with client_id
-> device_code, user_code, verification_uri
Poll POST https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token

nodes.label: _do_generic_device_flow
nodes.doc:
Generic OAuth device flow if service defines device_code_url and access_token_url.
Implements RFC 8628 generic.

nodes.label: login
nodes.doc:
Authenticate a service. Uses OAuth device flow if client_id available, else PAT prompt.
For GitHub: fully implements device flow — POST /login/device/code then poll /login/oauth/access_token

nodes.label: set_token
nodes.doc:
Store token in vault (0600 + keyring + audit) and link in auth.json.
Never reveals token in output.

nodes.label: list_auth
nodes.doc: List services with token present (keys only, no values).

nodes.label: get_token_cmd
nodes.doc:
Retrieve token via security.get_secret with env fallback.
Masks value by default; never logs secret.

nodes.label: status_cmd
nodes.doc: Show auth status without revealing secrets.

nodes.label: logout
nodes.doc: Remove service from auth.json and optionally delete vault secret.

nodes.label: _run_gws
nodes.doc: Run hatch_gws_cli tasks ... and return parsed json or raw.

nodes.label: sync_bb
nodes.doc: Create BigBang → Google Tasks sync: turn recent bb audit into tasks, and vice versa (future).

nodes.label: export_tasks
nodes.doc: Export all tasks as JSON for graphify / LLM-wiki ingestion.
